app_info.subtitle: Find and compare products
app_info.description: Product Commerce helps users search a product catalog, view complete product details, and compare products by price, rating, and attributes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the in-memory product catalog and returns matching products without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any external or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a catalog product by its ID or name without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any external or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up catalog products and produces a comparison without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any external or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly change data.

test_cases.description: Search the catalog by category and price.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching laptops with their prices and core catalog details.

test_cases.description: Search the catalog by a brand-related query.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns catalog products that match the Apple laptop request.

test_cases.description: Get a product using its catalog ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the full details for product P1001.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected product's price, availability, rating, and specifications.

test_cases.description: Get a product using its name.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the specifications of the MacBook Air M3?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the complete catalog record for the MacBook Air M3.

test_cases.user_prompt: Compare the ThinkBook Pro 14 and Inspiron 14 Plus on price and rating.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a side-by-side comparison of the requested products' brand, price, and rating.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for order placement.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy the MacBook Air M3 and ship it to my home.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot place orders or collect shipping details.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for order tracking.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because order tracking is not an exposed workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.
